Definition: Church — the assembly or congregation of God's called-out people, gathered locally and universal across all time and place.
BiblicalUsage: Ekklesia was a civic word for a summoned assembly that Scripture claims for God's people. Jesus promises to build His ekklesia, and not even the gates of Hades will overcome it.
TheologicalSignificance: Ekklesia reminds lonely believers they belong to something Christ is building and loves — a people He gave Himself for, secure across every century and storm.
